messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Problem with INLA after updating to R 4.3.1
parts:
No,
this is unrelated to fmesher and is instead due to "readlink -f" (as
is used in the mac.arm64/inla.run script) not being valid on pre-12.3
mac.
Finn
